lastUserInput: Do these steps in order, one tool call each, then stop and reply DONE. Use your file tools (not the shell) for steps 1-3. 1) Read src/a.rs. 2) Edit src/a.rs so the function returns 2 instead of 1. 3) Create a new file src/b.rs containing exactly: fn b() {} 4) Run the shell command: git status --short 5) List the src directory with your directory listing tool. 6) Search for the text fn under src with your search tool.
